```{r}
# Load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(lubridate)
library(here)
```

## 1. Import data

```{r}
# Import CSV datasets
estuary_metadata <- read_csv(
  here("data", "workshop2", "estuary_metadata.csv"))

estuary_sonde_data <- read_csv(
  here("data", "workshop2", "estuary_sonde_data.csv"))

species_dictionary <- read_csv(
  here("data", "workshop2", "species_dictionary.csv"))
```

```{r}
# Check imported datasets
glimpse(estuary_metadata)
glimpse(estuary_sonde_data)
glimpse(species_dictionary)
```

## 2. Import and combine catch log sheets

```{r}
# Check the sheet names in the catch log
catch_sheets <- excel_sheets(
  here("data", "workshop2", "estuary_catch_log.xlsx"))

catch_sheets
```

```{r}
# Read all catch-log sheets and combine them
catch_log <- catch_sheets |>
  set_names() |>
  map_dfr(
    ~ read_excel(
      here("data", "workshop2", "estuary_catch_log.xlsx"),
      sheet = .x),
    .id = "sheet_name")
# Check
glimpse(catch_log)
head(catch_log)
```

```{r}
# Check catch-log column names
names(catch_log)
```

```{r}
# Preview the combined catch log
head(catch_log)
```

## 3. Clean catch log

```{r}
# Standardise site and species names
catch_clean <- catch_log |>
  mutate(
    site = str_to_lower(site),
    site = str_trim(site),
    site = str_replace_all(site, " ", "_"),
    
    species = str_to_lower(species),
    species = str_trim(species),
    species = str_replace_all(species, " ", "_"))
```

```{r}
# Check cleaned values
unique(catch_clean$site)
unique(catch_clean$species)
```

```{r}
# Inspect metadata and species dictionary
names(estuary_metadata)
head(estuary_metadata)

names(species_dictionary)
head(species_dictionary)
```

```{r}
# Clean metadata site names
metadata_clean <- estuary_metadata |>
  mutate(
    site_name = str_to_lower(site_name),
    site_name = str_trim(site_name),
    site_name = str_replace_all(site_name, " ", "_"))
#Check 
unique(metadata_clean$site_name)
```

## 4. Clean sonde data

```{r}
# Inspect sonde data
names(estuary_sonde_data)
head(estuary_sonde_data)
```

```{r}
# Clean sonde timestamps and sensor error values
sonde_clean <- estuary_sonde_data |>
  mutate(
    timestamp = dmy_hm(timestamp),
    turbidity = na_if(turbidity, -999))
glimpse(sonde_clean)
```

```{r}
# Create daily water quality summaries
daily_sonde <- sonde_clean |>
  mutate(
    date = floor_date(timestamp, unit = "day")) |>
  group_by(site, date) |>
  summarise(
    mean_temperature = mean(temperature, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_salinity = mean(salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")
# Check
head(daily_sonde)
```

## 5. Add scientific names

```{r}
# Join scientific names to the catch data
catch_taxonomy <- catch_clean |>
  left_join(
    species_dictionary,
    by = join_by(species == common_name))
# Check
head(catch_taxonomy)
```

```{r}
# Check for any species that failed to match
catch_clean |>
  anti_join(
    species_dictionary,
    by = join_by(species == common_name))
```

## 6. Create master dataset

```{r}
# Join catch data with spatial metadata
master_data <- catch_taxonomy |>
  left_join(
    metadata_clean,
    by = join_by(site == site_name))
```

```{r}
# Join daily water-quality summaries
master_data <- master_data |>
  left_join(
    daily_sonde,
    by = join_by(site, date))
```

```{r}
# Inspect 
glimpse(master_data)
# Check
head(master_data)
```

## 7. Build zero-catch framework

```{r}
# Create all site-date-species combinations
catch_complete <- catch_taxonomy |>
  complete(
    site,
    date,
    scientific_name) |>
  mutate(
    count = coalesce(count, 0))
# Check
head(catch_complete)
glimpse(catch_complete)
```

```{r}
# Rebuild master dataset with zero-catch rows included
master_data <- catch_complete |>
  left_join(
    metadata_clean,
    by = join_by(site == site_name)) |>
  left_join(
    daily_sonde,
    by = join_by(site, date))
```

```{r}
# Inspect
glimpse(master_data)
# Check for zero catches
master_data |>
  filter(count == 0) |>
  head()
```

## 8. Statistical summary

```{r}
# Calculate summary statistics by species and zone
summary_table <- master_data |>
  group_by(scientific_name, zone) |>
  summarise(
    mean_catch = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_catch = sd(count, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sqrt(sum(!is.na(count))),
    
    avg_salinity = mean(mean_salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_salinity = sd(mean_salinity, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sqrt(sum(!is.na(mean_salinity))),
    
    .groups = "drop") |>
  rename(
    mean_salinity = avg_salinity)
summary_table
```

## 9. Visualise fish abundance along the salinity gradient

```{r}
# Create italicised scientific-name labels
plot_data <- master_data |>
  mutate(
    facet_label = paste0("italic('", scientific_name, "')"))
# Plot fish abundance along the salinity gradient
ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(x = mean_salinity, y = count)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ facet_label,
    labeller = label_parsed) +
 labs(
  title = "Fish abundance along the Ross River Estuary salinity gradient",
  subtitle = "Salinity increases from upstream freshwater sites toward the estuary mouth",
  x = "Mean daily salinity",
  y = "Fish abundance") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 10. Final data checks

```{r}
# Check final master dataset
glimpse(master_data)

# Confirm there are no legacy -999 sensor errors
any(master_data == -999, na.rm = TRUE)

# Confirm zero-catch observations were included
master_data |>
  filter(count == 0) |>
  head()

# View final statistical summary
summary_table
```
